_doc: Declarative boundary table for scripts/check_boundaries.py. Each rule: id; dirs (path prefixes, '' = whole repo); exclude_prefixes; exts (null = every file); patterns [{re, msg, strip_strings, strip_line_comment, mask, skip_line_re}]; comment_prefixes (a line whose body starts with one is skipped); allow_files (exact repo paths); allow_basenames; allow_list_file (one repo path per line, # comments); allow_substrings_file (grep -F style, matched against 'path:content'); floor {min, exts, kind: corpus|matching_files}; kind py_call runs a python function over each file. Rationale of each rule sits in 'why'.

rules.why: RenderWorld boundary (spec 2026-05-22-renderworld-boundary-spec section 12): engine-pure modules may not include game-side headers.

patterns.msg: forbidden include of a game-side header

rules.why: Forward-decls, signatures and aliases of game-side types that an include-only check misses.
editor/ routes all GPU access through EditorBridge: no direct include of the GPU-internal batcher/registry/cull headers.

patterns.msg: editor/ must route GPU access through EditorBridge

rules.why: Simulation never reads audio-device state (wall-clock playback position forked mc2_16, 2026-10-12). Only the sound system and the radio queue read gosAudio_Get*.

patterns.msg: audio-state read outside mclib/soundsys.cpp and code/gamesound.cpp

rules.why: Sim translation units read node positions only through Appearance::simNode*/simHitNode*/simWeaponNodePosition (the sim pose). The legacy get*NodePosition virtuals and drawNode* pick the draw shape by a thread-local phase flag; a sim call that reaches them returns a plausible camera-dependent number (UNIT-VISUAL-SNAP-1: baseRootNodeHeight leaked into saves). currentLOD is camera-distance render state. Presentation TUs are allowlisted by path: weaponbolt_render.cpp and missiongui_support.cpp (render/UI), artlry.cpp (the presentation-only bomber), mech_value_codec.h (writes the derived currentLOD as zero).

patterns.msg: draw-node accessor in a sim TU: use Appearance::simNode*/simHitNode*/simWeaponNodePosition
currentLOD is camera-dependent render state; sim TUs must not read it

rules.why: GL is gone from the engine: no GL header include in owned C/C++.

patterns.msg: GL header include in owned code

rules.why: GL is gone from the engine: no gl*() call in owned C/C++ (comment text and string literals ignored).
Only the registry/profile parser TUs and their focused tests include nlohmann/json. Floor 1 distinguishes clean from looked-at-nothing.

patterns.msg: json isolation violated: nlohmann/json include outside the allowed TUs

rules.why: The GPU particle pipeline projects on the GPU only; CPU projection APIs inside mclib/particles/ regress the gosFX retirement (plan 2026-05-20 section 5.4).
F1 retirement: the terrainMVP uniform no longer exists; no shader may reference it.
No CPU code looks up the retired uniform names by string literal (the gos_SetTerrainMVP API half was adjudicated rot 2026-07-30).

patterns.msg: legacy terrainMVP/u_terrainMVP string-literal uniform lookup in CPU code

rules.why: F1 retirement: the abs(clip.w) round-trip kludge is gone.
F1 retirement: terrainViewport / u_terrainViewport are gone.
F1 retirement: no screen-rhw round trip in shaders.
F1 retirement: no bare mvp uniform outside the allowlisted shadow/HUD shaders.

patterns.msg: bare mvp uniform in a non-allowlisted shader

rules.why: gate::raw / envText / boolState are display-only readers; decisions go through the typed registry. Logic lives in scripts/check-gate-echo-reads.py (check_text), run per file here.
